firm handshake
/fɜːm ˈhænd.ʃeɪk/
👆 Tap to flip the card
firm handshake
🇬🇧 English meaning
A confident, strong handshake, often seen as a sign of good character.
🇻🇳 Vietnamese meaning
Cái bắt tay chắc chắn, mạnh mẽ
📌 Note
Set phrase — the verb 'bide' is only used in this expression.
🔗 Collocation
give a firm handshake; a firm handshake is important
✍️ 3 examples
1. A firm handshake is often the first impression you make at a job interview.
2. He greeted me with a firm handshake and a warm smile.
